localeSwitcher.label: Language
fieldHelp.providers: Each enabled provider checks the domain independently; if even one says "block", the quorum blocks (OR logic). More providers means wider coverage, but more third parties see your queries.
fieldHelp.timeoutMode: How to treat a provider that didn't answer in time. "fail_open" (default) - pass through, treating it as safe; "fail_closed" - block; "degraded" - like fail_open, but explicitly marks the decision as incomplete in the log.
fieldHelp.cache: Min/max lifetime of a cache entry (caps the provider's own TTL), how long to keep a "blocked" verdict, and how many entries the cache holds at once before it starts evicting the oldest.
fieldHelp.overrides: Your own exceptions on top of the quorum: the allowlist always allows, the blocklist always blocks, regardless of what the providers say. On conflict between the two lists, the allowlist wins.
fieldHelp.logFilters: Search and filters only act within the current log window - the last ~1000 queries or 24 hours; older entries are no longer kept.
hero.SERVICE_UNREACHABLE.detail: The filtering service isn't responding. Check that it's running.
hero.WATCHDOG_GAVE_UP.detail: Automatic restart failed. Restart the application manually.
hero.WATCHDOG_RESTARTING.detail: The filtering service is being restarted. Please wait a few seconds.
hero.OFFLINE.detail: Resolution is paused until the connection is restored.
hero.PAUSED.detail: DNS is working, but without the filter: quorum and GeoIP are off. Your own block/allow lists still apply. Resume from the tray icon menu.
hero.NO_PROVIDERS.detail: Filtering is off - no provider is active.
hero.CERT_NOT_TRUSTED.detail: The local certificate hasn't been added to trusted root certificates. Without it, the browser won't trust the settings page.
hero.CERT_UNKNOWN.detail: Couldn't verify the local certificate's status.
hero.PROTECTED.detailWithBlocked: Filtering is active. {blocked} blocked in the current log.
hero.installFailedLabel: Failed — use the tray icon menu instead
app.queryLogPersistWarning: The query log is saved to disk in an encrypted file (query-log.enc) - this keeps browsing history across restarts. To disable: persist_query_log = false in resolver_config.toml.
app.cachePersistWarning: The verdict cache is saved to disk in an encrypted file (cache.enc) - which domains were resolved is kept across restarts. To disable: persist_cache = false in resolver_config.toml.
app.personalZonePersistWarning: The rating filter's personal learned zone is saved to disk in an encrypted file (personal-zone.enc) - this remembers which sites you visit often/regularly. To disable: [personal_zone] enabled = false in resolver_config.toml.
warning.notPersisted: The change was applied but NOT saved to disk - it will not survive a service restart.

cctldBlock.heading: ccTLD block
cctldBlock.description: Blocks the whole domain if it ends in the chosen TLD code (e.g. .ru).
cctldBlock.overBlockingWarning: Blocking by ccTLD catches every domain under that suffix - regardless of who actually runs the site or where its content is hosted. Many legitimate sites register under a TLD that doesn't match their own jurisdiction (e.g. .io/.co) for reasons unrelated to it.
cctldBlock.inputPlaceholder: Add a code - country or code (e.g. ru)…
geoip.heading: GeoIP block
geoip.noDatabaseStatus: The GeoIP database isn't loaded yet - country filtering isn't in effect right now, regardless of the list below.
geoip.unknownBuildDateStatus: The GeoIP database is loaded; its build date is unknown.
geoip.overBlockingWarning: Large CDNs (Cloudflare, Google, Amazon) hand out anycast addresses whose apparent geography changes between requests - blocking a country risks blocking legitimate sites that simply route through a data center in that country, with no actual tie to its jurisdiction.
geoip.invalidCodeTemplate: "{code}" isn't a valid two-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).
